title: Diffusion training: GPU-independent constraints and stack notes (diffusers, DiffSynth-Studio, DiT, accelerate)
summary: constraints are probe-first hints (never a veto), scoped to the library versions they were seen on; rules are script bugs and library facts found while building the harvest

message: CheckpointError: diffusers --gradient_checkpointing (the model's own checkpointing) under accelerate FSDP2 full shard
fix: use accelerate's FSDP activation checkpointing (fsdp_activation_checkpointing: true) without --gradient_checkpointing (FF08 ran)

message: diffusers 0.41.0 train_dreambooth_lora_qwen_image.py with --offload and without --cache_latents: the VAE encodes the batch while still on the CPU (device mismatch)
fix: add --cache_latents with --offload (QL07 ran: 0.8555 s/update) or drop --offload

text: diffusers 0.41.0 train_dreambooth_lora_flux.py: with --instance_prompt and no caption column, CLIP + T5 still run every step (the pre-computed prompt embeddings are overwritten), so the text encoders stay resident and cost the same as per-image captions (FL05 vs FL00: x0.997); a copy that reuses the pre-computed embeddings gives the real cache (FL15 vs FL05, both one instance prompt: x1.03, -4.7 GiB).
diffusers 0.41.0 train_dreambooth_lora_qwen_image.py with --caption_column crashes (prompt_embeds_mask is None); the harvest ran a patched copy (QL00).

diffusers train_dreambooth_flux.py with DeepSpeed ZeRO-3 under accelerate 1.15 crashes at load ("max_position_embeddings: 0"): accelerate keeps the HF ZeRO-3 weakref, so the frozen CLIP / T5 load partitioned, also with zero3_init_flag false; unset it while the frozen models load (FF00 ran with that patch).

Forcing one SDPA backend (sdpa_kernel with a single backend) breaks calls it cannot serve: VAE attention with strided inputs, SD1.5 UNet head dim 160 (> 128 for cuDNN). Put the backend first in the priority list instead (torch.nn.attention.sdpa_kernel([...], set_priority=True)) so the other calls fall back; the harvest's cudnn_prio state is that.

DiffSynth-Studio 2.1.12: Wan's attention takes FlashAttention-3 > FlashAttention-2 > torch SDPA by import (DIFFSYNTH_ATTENTION_IMPLEMENTATION does not apply; set diffsynth.models.wan_video_dit.FLASH_ATTN_2_AVAILABLE and FLASH_ATTN_3_AVAILABLE to False to get torch SDPA - hiding the flash_attn package breaks transformers' import); FLUX.1 and Qwen-Image call torch SDPA directly (set the SDPA priority); Z-Image uses DiffSynth's core attention, chosen by DIFFSYNTH_ATTENTION_IMPLEMENTATION (flash_attention_2 / flash_attention_4 / torch / xformers).

DiffSynth-Studio 2.1.12 setup: Wan pipelines redirect the T5 / VAE .pth files to DiffSynth-Studio/Wan-Series-Converted-Safetensors (download it as well); the Qwen-Image trainer loads the Qwen/Qwen-Image-Edit processor even for text-to-image.

flash-attn 2.8.3 built from its sdist also installs an older flash_attn/cute/ package and overwrites the flash-attn-4 (4.0.0b36) files when it is installed second: `from flash_attn.cute import flash_attn_func` then fails (cutlass.cute.core has no ThrMma) and DiffSynth-Studio silently loses FlashAttention-4 (GDZ01 crashed with NameError flash_attn_func_cute until flash-attn-4 was reinstalled). Install flash-attn-4 after flash-attn 2.x. Without DIFFSYNTH_ATTENTION_IMPLEMENTATION, DiffSynth-Studio 2.1.12 picks the first importable of FlashAttention-4 > 3 > 2 > SageAttention > xformers > torch for its core attention (Z-Image), so the install order also changes the default.

Measuring with a small synthetic dataset: every epoch boundary re-spawns the DataLoader workers and stalls the step (~0.7 s every 16 steps for SD1.5 at 512 px, window mean / median 1.13; SDXL 1.23); report the median step and keep the stall out of A/B comparisons.

Counting updates under DeepSpeed ZeRO: the engine steps the inner torch optimizer once per parameter sub-group, so a torch optimizer step hook over-counts; count DeepSpeedEngine.step calls at gradient-accumulation boundaries.
